notes.title: Goblin.Life is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39541942/4a15b8d6d0296cc4a7772930dabfc52c9a361e0d.png[/img]

Wow! 

Its been a long journey to get here but Goblin.Life is now live! Come join us and play around in the vibrant dream worlds imagined by friends like you. 

Link your friends your creations and they can play in the browser for free but as a Steam user you have full Imagination access. What worlds will you create? I can't wait!

Interlink the dream worlds with the Gateway system. This lets you create your own network of dreams that you and your friends have created. Persist the Dreams locally by saving or research the source control ways documented in the Goblinomikon. 

See you in the Life ~ 

A Goblin King

notes.title: Goblin.Life Demo Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39541942/ad1feb3d7a10acc86c6d03909348b07f25f4c11f.png[/img]

Come play the [i]Goblin.Life[/i] Demo and discover what [i]Imagination with Friends[/i] can be about. 

- Brush 3D tiles into inherently multiplayer worlds with the [i]Imagination[/i] editor.
- Play your favorite tabletop games on real-time updatable multiplayer maps. Leave a lasting impression with that next fireball.
- Carve astral glyphs to add interactive, highly moddable elements to your [i].Goblin[/i] saves until they become [i].Goblin Games[/i]
- Glyphs control everything; spawning Goblins(AI), controlling the weather, creating portals to other realms. Very powerful stuff!
- Inherently multiplayer and linkable, copy and paste from the main menu to share links to your friends.
- Upload your creations via GitHub or the Steam workshop in the Full Version to create permanent URLs to your [i].Goblin Games[/i].

[b]
# WHEN ? [/b]
February the 1st, 2021 - Noon PST

[b]# WHAT ?[/b]
Goblin.Life Demo is available for everyone! Free!
